product.name: Online Pharmacy Ordering and Delivery Service
product.description: A platform allowing users to order medicines and pharmacy products online for delivery from nearby licensed pharmacies.

product.name: Pharmacist Consultation Service
product.description: A 24/7 online service connecting users with licensed pharmacists for medication and health-related inquiries.

product.name: Medication Reminder Service
product.description: A feature that sends users text message reminders to take their medications on schedule.

product.name: Subscription Discount Service (Wafr Plus)
product.description: An annual subscription service offering users discounts on pharmacy products and free shipping.

product.name: Pharmacy Partner Network Platform
product.description: A platform enabling pharmacies to join Chefaa’s network to increase sales through online orders and delivery.
